title: Mohuna Media — Branding for an Assam News Channel | Studio 1947
description: How Studio 1947 crafted a culturally rooted brand identity and business card system for Mohuna Media, an independent Assam news channel documenting Brahmaputra river livelihoods.
ogTitle: Mohuna Media — Branding for an Assam News Channel | Studio 1947
ogDescription: A cohesive brand identity built on confluence, community and storytelling from the heart of Assam, honoring Brahmaputra river livelihoods.

hero.alt: Mohuna Media master brand mark representing the Brahmaputra river and community livelihoods

body: Studio 1947 collaborated with Mohuna Media (muhonamedia.com) to develop a compelling visual brand identity and physical collateral system for an independent Assam-based news channel.

The name "Mohuna" signifies the confluence where rivers meet—a powerful metaphor for the intersection of climate, culture, and human stories that form the core of their journalistic mission. Our mandate was to craft a memorable logo and business card system that honors the heritage of the Brahmaputra region while asserting broadcast authority.

sections.heading: Logo Symbolism & Narrative Architecture
sections.label: The Mission
body: The logo represents the livelihoods of people living around the Brahmaputra River. It highlights key activities such as agriculture, fishery, local artisanship, and water transport that sustain the community.

Each element reflects how the river supports farming, fishing, traditional crafts, and movement of people and goods. Overall, the design symbolizes the strong connection between the river and the everyday lives of the people.

cards.title: Agriculture & Farming
cards.body: Honoring the fertile riverbanks and agricultural rhythms that feed riverine communities across Assam.

cards.title: Fishery & River Ecology
cards.body: Celebrating the traditional fishing practices and aquatic harmony sustaining families along the Brahmaputra.

cards.title: Local Artisanship
cards.body: Weaving traditional crafts, silk handlooms, and indigenous technical knowledge into the visual identity.

cards.title: Water Transport & Confluence
cards.body: Reflecting boats, ferries, and riverways that connect isolated islands (Char areas) to mainstream economic life.

sections.heading: Brand Collateral & Business Cards
sections.label: Collateral Design
body: We engineered a clean business card system that balances journalistic authority with regional warmth. Featuring balanced white space and riverine motifs, the stationery makes a lasting impression during field reporting and press engagements.

sections.heading: Client Impact & Outcomes
sections.label: Measuring Success
list: Authentic Regional Authority: Built a logo and brand language that immediately connects with audiences across Assam and the Northeast.
Unified Touchpoints: Created consistent brand representation across their web platform (muhonamedia.com), social channels, and physical press passes/business cards.
Credibility in Journalism: Established a professional visual identity that commands trust among readers, interviewees, and field sources.
